notes: Campaign 1 (random draw) music-teacher usage.mjs 6/8 caught; campaign 2 platform/privacy/browser-signals.mjs 5/8. After triage: 2 equivalent, 5 gaps, all caught_after_fix. The usage escape is already covered repo-wide by usage_contract.mjs. Hunt: usage_contract skipped 264 modules of other designs; a probe over the 209 recordUsage(storage,...) copies found the blocked/full/corrupt-store throws. Guard added: check_storage_guard.py bare_storage_args + exemption removed (runs in portfolio-validate.yml already). Verification: run_venture_tests.py over all 253 changed ventures, platform/privacy and platform/proposal suites, test_check_storage_guard (28 OK), check_storage_guard.py and usage_contract.mjs clean, all 5 privacy catalogue checkers clean, Chromium blocked-storage check on artificial-turf-bid-calculator (main: preset ignored, 2 errors; fixed: updates, 0 errors).

mutants.note: noStorage() catch branch: when reading the localStorage global throws, every later access (usageOptedOut, record, readUsage, setUsageOptOut) is itself inside try/catch and falls back to the same result ({} / no write / not opted out), so returning false instead of true changes nothing a visitor sees.

Venture suite only stored objects or unparseable text. Added usage.test.mjs test storing 5, "text", true, [1,2], null. The class is already guarded repo-wide by platform/ci/usage_contract.mjs (via check_storage_guard.py in portfolio-validate.yml), which stores the same non-object values.
maxBuffer doubled from 256 MiB to 512 MiB; ls-files output for ventures/ is a few hundred KB, so the larger cap is never reached.
The dist test always passed two untracked paths. Added "discovery skips build output even when it is the only untracked file".

mutants.before: if (made && typeof made === "object") callRecorders(made, storage, eventNames);
mutants.after: if (made || typeof made === "object") callRecorders(made, storage, eventNames);

mutants.note: No fixture had a create* factory returning null; with || null reaches Object.entries and the module reads as error. Added "a factory that returns null is skipped...".

real_defects.issue: Parameter-design usage counters defaulted to `storage = globalThis.localStorage` and pages called recordUsage/readOptOut/writeOptOut(localStorage, ...): with site data blocked, reading the global throws SecurityError at the call site, so the calculator's change handler threw before update(). Reproduced in Chromium on artificial-turf-bid-calculator (preset change left the bid unchanged; 2 page errors). Fixed: exported usageStorage() guard, defaults and call sites use it.

recordUsage(storage, ...) threw on a full store (setItem QuotaExceeded) or corrupt stored JSON (118) or a stored number/null (3), all origins share marisstella.app's quota. Probe drove every copy. Fixed: body wrapped in try.

Generated proposal block called loadCompany/saveCompany/forgetCompany(localStorage, ...) unguarded; restoreCompany() at load threw with site data blocked, skipping the rest of setup, and the forget-details button threw before clearing fields. Fixed in the template and all generated/hand-ported pages via companyStorage().
recordUsage read localStorage.getItem(OPT_OUT) outside any try and wrote to the parsed counter with no shape check. Surfaced by check_storage_guard once its exemption was removed. Fixed.

Skipped every usage.mjs containing `storage = globalThis.localStorage` and never looked at pages, so the bare-read crash above passed CI on 247 modules. Fixed: exemption removed, new bare_storage_args rule over pages importing ./usage.mjs (found 22 more call sites in 9 ventures on first run), 6 new tests.

165 bare `localStorage` reads outside try remain in non-usage helpers (saveBid/clearBid x50 each, drafts, scenarios, handoffs): each is a control that throws for a visitor blocking site data. Measure: for each tracked ventures html, run check_storage_guard.unguarded_reads over each inline <script> body. Fix: route through a guarded getter like usageStorage()/companyStorage(), then extend bare_storage_args (or unguarded_reads over inline scripts) to pages generally with a zero baseline.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: probe + sweep of ~560 files, lint, browser repro

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
